summary: Wangduephodrang district is overwhelmingly forested, covering 2,504.61 km² (62.1 %). The next most extensive land‑use is alpine scrub at 483.36 km² (12.0 %), followed by rocky outcrops (302.82 km², 7.5 %) and a combination of meadows, shrubs, snow and glacier each around 5 % of the area. Agricultural, water, and built‑up land together account for only 2.5 % of the district.
